clue.text: Makes headway with a lady from Italy

parts.note: to march is to advance steadily, so makes headway gives marches

explanation.surface: Someone making progress in the company of an Italian woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A marchesa is the wife of a marquis in Italy, a titled noblewoman.

clue.text: First male scholar in literature

parts.note: Adam is the first man in the Bible
the Venerable Bede was the great Anglo-Saxon scholar and historian

explanation.surface: The earliest man to be learned in books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link: the wordplay is placed in the literature. The answer is a novel by George Eliot.
explanation.definitionFit: Adam Bede is a George Eliot novel, so it is a work of literature.

clue.text: Policeman is soon involved with motorway crime

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are mixed together

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A police officer will soon be caught up in a motorway offence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' turns IS SOON, M and CRIME into one jumbled pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A commissioner is the head of a police force, such as London's Metropolitan Police.

clue.text: Appearing to come together in network?

indicators.note: in places the word for coming together inside the other piece

parts.note: read as net worked, the letters of net rearranged
to merge is to come together

explanation.surface: Things meeting up inside a web of connections.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the split: 'network' is NET worked, i.e. rearranged to ENT, with MERGE put inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something emergent is coming into view, newly arising.

clue.text: Extent to which Sheridan's character plays a part?

definitions.text: Extent to which Sheridan's character plays a part?

parts.words: Extent to which Sheridan's character plays a part?
parts.note: Bob Acres is a character in Sheridan's play The Rivals; the clue imagines a word for how much of the stage Acres occupies, which happens to mean area of land

explanation.surface: A question about how large a role a Sheridan character has.
explanation.walkthrough: Richard Brinsley Sheridan was an 18th-century Irish playwright; Bob Acres is the bumbling squire in The Rivals.
explanation.definitionFit: Acreage is an area of land measured in acres, so it is an extent.

clue.text: Stage is happy to accommodate such a dancer

indicators.note: the phrase holds the answer within its letters, giving it room

explanation.surface: A theatre is glad to house a particular kind of performer.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across staGE IS HAppy.
explanation.definitionFit: A geisha is a Japanese hostess trained in dance and music.

clue.text: Walk of a tailless animal

indicators.note: tailless means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a stoat is a small animal of the weasel family

explanation.surface: A stroll taken by an animal that has lost its tail.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoa is a covered colonnade in ancient Greece, used as a walkway.

clue.text: She wanders into a low bar joining agent

indicators.note: into places the scrambled word inside the other pieces

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable bar

indicators.note: wanders suggests moving about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman drifts into a seedy pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanders' gives HES from SHE; 'into' puts it inside A DIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: An adhesive is glue, a substance that sticks things together.

clue.text: It is said in France in the articles of faith, and believed

indicators.note: in places the French word inside the word for a statement of belief

parts.note: a creed is a set of articles of faith
dit is French for said

explanation.surface: A French saying found within religious doctrine, and accepted as true.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit something is to believe it, so credited means trusted as true.

clue.text: Possibly the date for fortune-telling

definitions.meaning: the date is one kind of ... tree
palmists read the ... of the hand to tell fortunes

explanation.surface: Maybe the appointment day is chosen by a fortune-teller.
explanation.definitionFit: Date palms are trees that bear dates, and the inside of the hand is read in palmistry.

clue.text: Note a request to redevelop the town centre

parts.note: to note something is to mark it

indicators.note: redevelop means rebuild, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A memo asking for the town centre to be rebuilt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to redevelop' turns A REQUEST into ETSQUARE.
explanation.definitionFit: The market square is the open central place of a traditional town.

clue.text: Agreeable conditions in the country

parts.note: people in agreement are united
states are conditions

explanation.surface: Pleasant circumstances found in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States is a nation, the USA.

clue.text: Tenant not so much at ease when speaking

indicators.note: when speaking signals that the words are said out loud

parts.note: less easy means not so much at ease

explanation.surface: An occupant feeling uncomfortable when talking.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessee holds a property on a lease, as a renter does.

clue.text: Pleased to order oil at one of these plants

parts.note: glad means pleased

indicators.note: to order means to arrange, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Happy to buy oil for one of the flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladioli are flowering plants with tall spikes of blooms.

clue.text: Seating arrangement for flower show

indicators.note: an arrangement puts things in a new order, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Organising the seats at a flower show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' reworks SEATING into the answer; 'for' and 'show' just complete the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Genista is the broom genus, a shrub with yellow blossoms.

clue.text: Note deficit on a carrier's list of explanations

parts.note: G is a musical note
a deficit is a loss
RY is the abbreviation for railway, a carrier of goods and passengers

explanation.surface: A memo about a shortfall on a transport firm's register.
explanation.definitionFit: A glossary is a list of terms with their meanings.

clue.text: More endearing truancy

definitions.meaning: from the proverb that being away makes the heart grow fonder
truancy is being away from school

explanation.surface: Skipping school is more charming.
explanation.definitionFit: Being away supposedly makes people fonder, and staying away from school is being away.

clue.text: Wild Miss Allen suffered a loss in command

indicators.note: suffered a loss means a letter is taken away from the name

parts.note: Barbara Allen is the heroine of a traditional ballad
IC is short for in charge, in command

explanation.surface: An unruly woman named Allen lost out while in control.
explanation.definitionFit: Barbaric means savage and uncivilised.

clue.text: Pass sum that is reallocated for sports centre

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass

indicators.note: reallocated means shared out again, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Approving money that has been shifted to a leisure facility.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reallocated' makes ISEUM from SUM and IE.
explanation.definitionFit: A coliseum is a large stadium or arena for games and shows.

clue.text: Vindication exemplified by Stonewall Jackson

definitions.meaning: the Confederate general got his nickname for standing firm like a stone wall

explanation.surface: Justification shown by a famous Civil War general.
explanation.definitionFit: A defence is a justification in argument, and stubborn resistance like a stone wall is a military defence.

clue.text: Command I leave to the big guns

indicators.note: leave means the letter departs from the word

parts.note: an ordinance is an authoritative command or decree

explanation.surface: An officer leaves the order to the artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordnance is heavy artillery, guns and cannon.

clue.text: Almost how Scrooge behaved

definitions.meaning: near means mean or stingy, as the miser Scrooge was

explanation.surface: Roughly the way Dickens's miser acted.
explanation.definitionFit: Near is an old word for stingy, and the adverb also means not quite.

clue.text: Fruit product

definitions.meaning: the fruit of labour is its outcome
a product is an outcome of a process

explanation.surface: Something produced from fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is both the fruit of an effort and its product.

clue.text: A river and sea manoeuvre to find the range

indicators.note: to manoeuvre is to move around, so these letters are moved about

explanation.surface: A naval exercise on river and sea to locate a firing range.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sierra Nevada is a mountain range in Spain and also in California.

clue.text: Behold the end of the agent

indicators.note: the end of picks the final letter of the word that follows

parts.note: an agent is a spy

explanation.surface: Look at the conclusion of a secret agent's story.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, to see.

clue.text: Old Thespian with a trunk

definitions.meaning: Sir Herbert Beerbohm ... was a Victorian actor-manager
a plant with a woody trunk

explanation.surface: A veteran actor carrying a large travelling case.
explanation.definitionFit: Herbert Beerbohm Tree was a famous actor, and a woody plant has a trunk.

clue.text: The state of Julia Ward Howe's hymn

definitions.text: The state of Julia Ward Howe's hymn

parts.words: The state of Julia Ward Howe's hymn
parts.note: Julia Ward Howe wrote the Battle Hymn of a nation's form of government, the American Civil War song

explanation.surface: Asking what condition a hymn writer's song is in.
explanation.definitionFit: A republic is a state without a monarch, as named in the Battle Hymn.

clue.text: Terpsichorean take-over bid

parts.note: Terpsichore is the muse of dance; the phrase is the polite request used to cut in and take a dancer's partner

explanation.surface: A corporate takeover attempt in the world of dance.
explanation.walkthrough: An excuse-me is a dance in which partners may be claimed by cutting in.
explanation.definitionFit: The polite words used to cut in on a dancing couple name a dance where partners change.
